rules: Each supplied form retains every Q001-Q055 row; unreviewed rows keep all scoring fields null
Completed input judgments require explicit target interpretation, support references, missing-link/ambiguity statements and conflict propositions
Completed claim reviews preserve every original sentence span, split separately judgeable propositions into atomic objects and confirm full-answer coverage
Citations require document_index (documents only), start, end and exact quote; offsets are Unicode character indices with exclusive end
Contradicted claims require a counterevidence citation; unsupported claims require an explicit missing link
Target answer support and withholding applicability are validated separately; explanation support is checked against authored explanation claims without scoring their meaning
For provided target answers, summarize authored target claims in order contradicted, unsupported, ambiguous, supported; this checks internal consistency only
Self-reported exposure is retained, not rejected or upgraded to proven independence; actual independent approval remains outside this intake
Compare only common item-level endpoints with prior author data; claim alignment and semantic adjudication require manual work
Preserve original author unknown; for endpoint comparison alone map unknown to ambiguous and retain both the raw and comparison value
A recorded input seal binds exact bytes and actual seal time; it does not prove absence of prior answer exposure
New received files or revisions use a separate run; frozen sources and earlier intake artifacts remain unchanged
